name: Bookmarks next to Jellyfin Enhanced's own bookmarks, in the je sandbox with the fixture (Jellyfin Enhanced's bookmarks on, in Plugin Pages and Custom Tabs): as admin, the drawer has our 'My Bookmarks' (Library tools, #/jfbm-bookmarks) and JE's 'Bookmarks' (Plugin Pages) once each, and no two drawer links share a label or a route; JE's own Bookmarks page opens in Plugin Pages' host and what it offers is recorded (its headings and buttons, a screenshot) for the switch-off step that notes it first; in the player our three OSD buttons and JE's bookmark button are there side by side with their own tooltips. Since 1.1.1 the click on JE's drawer link waits for the drawer to settle (JE adds its own entry above the libraries a moment after the drawer is built, which moves JE's link down onto where Sign Out was), and when the address doesn't change it clicks once more, then opens the link's href, recorded in 'how JE's page was opened'.

steps.name: sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran and JE loaded
open the drawer
drawer open with our link and JE's Plugin Pages link
steps.waitFor: (() => { const ours = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .jfkit-nav a[data-jfbm-nav="bookmarks"]'); const je = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid="Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyfinEnhanced.BookmarksPage"]'); return !!ours && !!je && ours.getClientRects().length > 0 && je.getClientRects().length > 0; })()

steps.name: the drawer settled: JE's own entry (Enhanced Panel) in it, or 5 s gone by; JE's Bookmarks link in the same place for 600 ms and under its own centre
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const el = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid="Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyfinEnhanced.BookmarksPage"]'); if (!el || el.getClientRects().length === 0) return false; globalThis.__jeDrawerSince = globalThis.__jeDrawerSince || Date.now(); if (!document.getElementById('jellyfinEnhancedSettingsLink') && Date.now() - globalThis.__jeDrawerSince < 5000) return false; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' }); const box = () => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map(Math.round).join(','); }; const first = box(); for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); if (!el.isConnected || box() !== first) return false; } const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2); return !!hit && el.contains(hit) && first; })()

steps.name: every link of the drawer
steps.eval: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer a[href]')).filter(a => a.getClientRects().length > 0).map(a => ({ text: (a.querySelector('.navMenuOptionText') || a).textContent.trim(), href: a.getAttribute('href'), itemId: a.getAttribute('data-itemid'), ours: a.hasAttribute('data-jfbm-nav') }))

steps.name: our 'My Bookmarks' and JE's 'Bookmarks' once each, on different routes; no two drawer links share a label or a route
steps.assert: (() => { const l = __vars.links; const texts = l.map(x => x.text).filter(Boolean); const hrefs = l.map(x => x.href).filter(h => h && h !== '#'); const ours = l.filter(x => x.text === 'My Bookmarks'); const je = l.filter(x => x.itemId === 'Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyfinEnhanced.BookmarksPage'); return ours.length === 1 && ours[0].ours && ours[0].href === '#/jfbm-bookmarks' && je.length === 1 && je[0].text === 'Bookmarks' && je[0].href !== ours[0].href && new Set(texts).size === texts.length && new Set(hrefs).size === hrefs.length; })()

steps.name: what JE's Bookmarks page offers (recorded: headings, buttons, inputs)
steps.eval: (() => { const page = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.page:not(.hide)')).pop() || document.body; const vis = (e) => e.getClientRects().length > 0; return { title: document.title, headings: Array.from(page.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4')).filter(vis).map(e => e.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 30), buttons: Array.from(page.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button], a.emby-button')).filter(vis).map(e => (e.getAttribute('title') || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.textContent || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 60), inputs: Array.from(page.querySelectorAll('input, select')).filter(vis).map(e => e.getAttribute('placeholder') || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.type).slice(0, 20), text: page.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 1500) }; })()
